ignored_stale_quality.name: PaperLeet quality gate
ignored_stale_quality.reason: Unstarted first-party manual ancestor request; exact canonical CI/Pages policies at both SHAs reject release of a non-current SHA.

guarded_push.scope: Mandatory wrapper runs checked release-chain audit and clean-worktree check before ordinary no-tag main push. A rejection prevents Git mutation; never followed by raw push.

generated_worker_derivation.scope: Exact esbuild regeneration in memory from recorded source graph; generated module and immutable asset bytes both match. Generated files are verified as build derivatives rather than Git blobs.

scope: Guarded ordinary main push; exact remote ref, tested Git blobs, generated worker derivatives and prior immutable assets verified. Actions observations apply at verification time only.
